name: Drawn To You ~ Art School Romance ~
source:
Liany is a freshman in the north Ashburg Institute of Art. Somehow though, her paintings still come out dull. Liana's best friend thinks she knows the answer - so can Liana find something that will inspire her? Or... someone? 

[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/dty.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
利亚尼是北阿什堡艺术学院的新生。但不知何故，她的画仍然显得平淡无奇。莉安娜最好的朋友认为她知道答案 - 那么莉安娜能找到一些能够激励她的东西吗？或者……某个人？

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/dty.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
